issues.title: Course lesson videos not playing for students
issues.problem_statement: Some of the customer's students say the lesson videos in the customer's course keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones; the customer said this was the third time they raised it.

items.description: Support opened the lesson link shared by the customer on a desktop in Chrome, in Safari and on a phone; the video played fine each time and support could not reproduce the problem.
evidence: I've opened it on my desktop in Chrome and the video plays fine.
It plays on Safari and on my phone too. So I cannot reproduce the problem from my side.

items.description: Support will raise the issue with the technical team and get back to the customer; support did not give a timeline.
evidence: I'll raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
I can't give you a timeline right now

items.description: Customer will ask one of the students to record a short screen recording showing the video loading and send it to support; support asked that it come along with the lesson link.
evidence: Okay, I'll ask one of the students to record it and send it to you.
a short screen recording from one affected student, showing the video loading, along with the lesson link.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call; issue unresolved with clear next steps on both sides.
